edges.reason: Constructor wires dependencies and then calls startGame() to open the first game.
Fallback forwards received ETH to buyTicket(address(0)).

start() settles the previous game through pickTheWinner().
start() opens the next game through startGame().
buyTicket() calls processReferralSystem(partner, msg.sender).
pickTheWinner() derives the winner from randomNumber() seeded with block.timestamp, making the result timestamp dependent.
pickTheWinner() pays referral partners via transferToPartner().
processReferralSystem() triggers partner payout through transferToPartner().
transferToPartner() computes the owed amount with getPartnerAmount().

getSalesPartnerAmount() external call to referralInstance.getSalesPartnerPercent(partner).
